description: Unsigned transactions for one founder action, checked against the contract for this wallet (publish_update also for the writer the founder invited, with campaignId): create (the company token and its first round, priced from the goal and the share sold; the creation fee to Sjothr is allowed first; optionally the company's country and registration number), propose_round (the next round, or the listing round that opens the token's market at the round price), open_round (after the backers' vote), finalize_round (close the round on sale), publish_update (progress on the public record: what was really done, with links and fingerprinted files), set_writer (invite the wallet of the founder's AI agent to publish updates, or remove it with writer null), request_release (next tranche of a round's capital, citing published updates), finalize_release (record the backers' vote), withdraw (released capital), cancel (stop the round on sale). Signed and sent by the founder's own wallet.

campaignId.description: Only for an invited writer (publish_update): the raise it writes for; the founder wallet's own raise is used otherwise

country.description: Two-letter country code of the company (create, optional)

days.description: Days the round stays on sale, counted after the backers' vote when they vote first (create, propose_round)

dossierHash.description: keccak256 of the dossier's exact bytes (create, propose_round)

dossierUri.description: Public HTTPS, IPFS or Arweave address of the round dossier (create, propose_round)

files.description: Public files of the update with the keccak256 of their exact bytes, taken when they were published: photos, videos, PDF (publish_update)

founderTokens.description: Founder's tokens in whole tokens, the only ones created with the raise (create)

goal.description: Funding goal of the round in USDC (create, propose_round)

links.description: Public proofs of the update: commits, articles, demos, on-chain transactions (publish_update)

listing.description: Listing round only: share of the round that opens the market (10-50%), creator fees on buys and sells (0-5%), founder lock-up in months (create, propose_round)

maxSupply.description: Maximum supply in whole tokens, never raised (create)

sharePercent.description: Share of the supply after the round that the round sells, in percent; sets the price (create, propose_round)

symbol.description: Token symbol, uppercase letters and digits (create)

updates.description: Numbers of the published updates the request rests on (request_release)

wallet.description: Address of the founder wallet that will sign and send

writer.description: Wallet of the founder's AI agent, or null to remove it (set_writer)

name: sjothr_founder_prepare
title: Prepare a founder action
